questions.question: When Jesus told the fisherman Simon to let down his nets, what did Simon say about the night before?

answers.text: We worked hard all night and caught nothing
We sold our whole catch before sunrise
A storm kept us on shore all night

questions.question: When Simon Peter saw two boats so full of fish that they began to sink, what did he do?
After the huge catch of fish, what did Simon Peter say to Jesus?

answers.text: Go away from me Lord because I'm a sinful man
Stay with me Lord because I need Your help
Teach me Lord how to find fish like that
